podcast.body: This 1975 debut solo album launched Nugent's solo career and notably featured "Stranglehold," an eight-minute display of "masterful guitar playing." The album and its lead track were intended as a powerful statement of defiance against a music industry that had previously rejected him. "In 1975, Nugent went solo. His first album, Ted Nugent featuring Stranglehold was eight minutes of masterful guitar playing by a man looking to make a statement."

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album was Ted Nugent's first multi-platinum solo record, released in 1975, and features the song "Queen of the Forest." Nugent stated that "Queen of the Forest" was dedicated to the great spirit, God, and nature's healing and guidance in his life. "That is Cleaner the Forest from Ted Nugent's self titled debut album released in 1975."
